text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered - INC6112233 for prometheus.scrape.throttle (prod). Auto-escalation in progress. Link: https://pd.example/INC6112233

pagerbot: Page fired to @Oncall SRE, @Kevin L, @Tara S (pagerduty rule: high-frequency scrape errors) :bell:

Maria H: acking. seeing a ton of 504/429 from scrape-proxy -> exporter. scrape success rate dropping fast.

Kevin L: +1. scrape-proxy logs show steady 429s starting ~10:06 UTC. exporters respond slow, some 503s. Also seeing log-ingest queue depth rising (~200k msgs).

Tara S: customer dashboards show missing metrics for frontend-service and kafka-consumer-lag. several customer alerts suppressed. Possible customer impact.

Maria H: quick mitigation plan: scale scrape-proxy and restart a couple ingestion workers. temp increase scrape timeout to 15s for heavy exporters.

Kevin L: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/scrape-proxy --replicas=6
kubectl -n monitoring rollout status deploy/scrape-proxy
```

Oncall SRE: scaling now. watching rollout.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: acknowledged by Maria H. Pager duty second/escalation suppressed while acked.

Oncall SRE: scrape-proxy rollout successful. new pods in rotation, but still seeing 503s from exporter-host-12 and host-14. suspect node egress saturation on those nodes.

Tara S: log-ingest autoscaler not firing; HPA CPU metric missing for ingestion-workers. that explains backlog growth. investigating HPA metrics pipeline.

Kevin L: restarting ingestion-worker-7 on cluster-ingest-2 to rebalance.

Maria H: restarted ingestion-worker-7: `kubectl -n logs delete pod ingestion-worker-7` -> new pod came up, workers rebalanced. queue depth down ~30% so far.

Customer Ops: we have tickets from two customers (Acme Cloud, Streamline Analytics) reporting missing metrics and delayed alerts. CS is triaging.

Tara S: opening a short customer-impact doc and pinging CS. Maria H can you paste affected customers and rough ETA?

Maria H: adding to incident doc: affected_customers = ["Acme Cloud", "Streamline Analytics"]. ETA for partial recovery ~30-45m, full catch-up TBD.

Oncall SRE: network team alerted (NET-3456) for node egress spikes. tagging netops and infra.

Kevin L: temporary config change pushed to prometheus: increased scrape_timeout to 15s for heavy exporters and lowered scrape_interval for small targets to reduce churn. will revert after stabilized.

Tara S: metrics: scrape success rate improved 54% -> 87% after scaling & restarts. log-ingest backlog still ~40k messages, dropping. customers see partial recovery of metrics.

Maria H: summary for handoff:
```
- Root cause: scrape-proxy saturation + node egress pressure -> exporters 429/504 -> missing scrapes + log-ingest backlog
- Actions taken: scaled scrape-proxy to 6 replicas, restarted ingestion-worker-7, bumped scrape timeout to 15s, alerted netops (NET-3456)
- Current status: monitoring, scrape success ~87%, log backlog ~40k and decreasing
- Impacted customers: Acme Cloud, Streamline Analytics (CS notified)
- Next steps: netops to investigate egress, follow up on HPA metric gap, postmortem to be led by Maria H
```

Kevin L: posting runbook note for night oncall. please watch for PD re-fires and queue plateau.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: monitoring. auto-escalation timer paused.

Oncall SRE: handing off to @Tara S for night-watch in ~45m. Tara please ack when you take over.

Tara S: acked. will take watch and coordinate with CS for customer follow-ups. :eyes:

Maria H: marking postmortem lead = @Maria H. I'll kick off a detailed timeline and remediation items tomorrow morning.

Kevin L: thumbs: :thumbsup: Good job team. leaving notes in runbook channel.

Customer Ops: CS has informed customers that we're investigating and expect metrics restoration within an hour. will update if anything changes.

Tara S: closing the live page - monitoring phase. will escalate if any regressions.

end of thread: brief handoff completed, incident being tracked inINC6112233 and NET-3456.
